shotFamily.description: High-level grouping of shot types by visual purpose and body coverage.

values.label: Full Body
values.description: Captures the model from head to toe. Used when the complete outfit and full silhouette must be visible.

values.label: Half Body
values.description: Captures either the upper or lower portion of the body. Used when the shot focuses on a specific garment region.

values.label: Upper Body
values.description: Focuses on the head, shoulders, torso, arms, neckline, sleeves, and upper garments.

values.label: Lower Body
values.description: Focuses on waist, hips, legs, hems, trouser breaks, skirts, shorts, and footwear.

values.label: Three Quarter Body
values.description: Captures most of the body but may crop below the knees, calves, or ankles depending on the shot intent.

values.label: Detail
values.description: Close-up shot focused on a specific garment construction, trim, texture, logo, closure, accessory, or styling detail.

values.label: Accessory
values.description: Shot focused primarily on accessories such as bags, jewelry, belts, eyewear, hats, watches, or footwear.

values.label: Garment Feature
values.description: Shot focused on a specific garment feature such as neckline, sleeve, hem, waistband, back design, pocket, slit, or closure.

values.label: Lookbook
values.description: Editorial or commercial shot where outfit presentation, styling, and brand mood matter more than strict product documentation.

values.label: Catalog
values.description: Clean product-focused shot used for e-commerce, catalog pages, marketplaces, and product evaluation.

values.label: Lifestyle
values.description: Contextual shot where environment, movement, or scene contributes to the product presentation.

bodyCoverage.description: Defines how much of the model's body should be visible in the frame.

values.label: Full Body
values.description: Model is visible from head to toe, including footwear.

values.label: Head to Knee
values.description: Model is visible from head to approximately the knees.

values.label: Head to Mid Calf
values.description: Model is visible from head to mid-calf. Useful for dresses, coats, and longer silhouettes.

values.label: Head to Ankle
values.description: Model is visible from head to ankle, usually excluding or partially excluding footwear.

values.label: Three Quarter Body
values.description: Most of the body is visible, but the lower legs or feet may be cropped depending on intent.

values.label: Upper Half
values.description: Model is visible from head or neck to waist, hips, or upper thigh depending on crop.

values.label: Lower Half
values.description: Model is visible from waist or hips down to feet or shoes.

values.label: Torso Only
values.description: Frame focuses on torso, chest, waist, sleeves, neckline, and upper garment details.

values.label: Waist Up
values.description: Model is visible from head to waist.

values.label: Chest Up
values.description: Model is visible from chest to head. Useful for neckline, collar, jewelry, and face styling.

values.label: Shoulder Up
values.description: Model is visible from shoulders to head. Mostly used for beauty, face, neckline, or accessory shots.

values.label: Neckline Focus
values.description: Shot focuses on the neckline, collar, upper chest, and related accessories.

values.label: Sleeve Focus
values.description: Shot focuses on sleeve shape, length, cuffs, construction, or fabric behavior.

values.label: Waist Focus
values.description: Shot focuses on waistline, waistband, belt, tuck, crop length, or garment transition.

values.label: Hip Focus
values.description: Shot focuses on hip fit, pockets, drape, garment fall, or lower torso details.

values.label: Leg Focus
values.description: Shot focuses on legs, trouser fit, skirt fall, shorts, slit, or lower garment shape.

values.label: Footwear Focus
values.description: Shot focuses on shoes, boots, sandals, socks, trouser break, or hem-footwear relationship.

values.label: Detail Only
values.description: Frame captures only a specific detail, not a meaningful body region.

values.label: Accessory Only
values.description: Frame captures an accessory as the main subject.

viewDirection.description: Defines the model/product orientation relative to the camera.

values.label: Front
values.description: Model faces directly toward the camera. Front of garment is visible.

values.label: Back
values.description: Model faces away from the camera. Back of garment is visible.

values.label: Left Side
values.description: Model is turned so the left side of the body or garment is visible.

values.label: Right Side
values.description: Model is turned so the right side of the body or garment is visible.

values.label: Side
values.description: Generic side-facing shot when left or right side does not need to be specified.

values.label: Front Left Three Quarter
values.description: Model is mostly front-facing but turned slightly toward the left, showing front and one side.

values.label: Front Right Three Quarter
values.description: Model is mostly front-facing but turned slightly toward the right, showing front and one side.

values.label: Front Three Quarter
values.description: Generic three-quarter front view when left/right direction is not important.

values.label: Back Left Three Quarter
values.description: Model is mostly back-facing but angled to show part of the side.

values.label: Back Right Three Quarter
values.description: Model is mostly back-facing but angled to show part of the side.

values.label: Back Three Quarter
values.description: Generic three-quarter back view when left/right direction is not important.

values.label: Over Shoulder Toward Camera
values.description: Body may face away or sideways while the face turns toward the camera.

values.label: Profile
values.description: Clean side profile emphasizing silhouette, posture, garment fall, and side construction.

values.label: Angled
values.description: Model is intentionally angled but does not map cleanly to a strict side or three-quarter view.

values.label: Detail View
values.description: View direction is determined by the garment feature being shown rather than full-body orientation.

values.label: Not Applicable
values.description: Used when the shot does not involve model orientation, such as flat product/accessory detail shots.

orientation.description: Defines the output frame orientation or composition format.

values.label: Portrait
values.description: Vertical frame. Most common for full-body fashion images.

values.label: Landscape
values.description: Horizontal frame. Useful for campaign, banner, editorial, or multi-subject shots.

values.label: Square
values.description: Equal width and height. Useful for marketplaces, social grids, and generic product presentation.

values.label: Vertical Close Crop
values.description: Vertical frame with tighter crop. Useful for upper-body, detail, or garment-zone shots.

values.label: Horizontal Close Crop
values.description: Horizontal frame with tighter crop. Useful for detail spreads or styling compositions.

values.label: Freeform
values.description: No strict orientation requirement. Use sparingly.

shotPurpose.description: Defines the primary commercial or production intent of the shot.

values.label: Complete Outfit Overview
values.description: Shows the full outfit clearly so buyers can assess the complete look.

values.label: Primary Catalog Image
values.description: Main clean product image for catalog, marketplace, or PDP usage.

values.label: Hero Image
values.description: Main visual image for lookbook, campaign, landing page, or product story.

values.label: Front Product View
values.description: Shows the front design, fit, neckline, closure, silhouette, and styling.

values.label: Back Product View
values.description: Shows back design, rear fit, back closure, straps, seams, or back silhouette.

values.label: Side Silhouette View
values.description: Shows side profile, garment fall, body contour, layering depth, and side construction.

values.label: Upper Garment Focus
values.description: Highlights tops, shirts, blouses, jackets, sweaters, neckline, sleeves, and torso fit.

values.label: Lower Garment Focus
values.description: Highlights trousers, jeans, skirts, shorts, hems, waistbands, leg shape, and footwear relationship.

values.label: Fit and Silhouette Evaluation
values.description: Helps evaluate garment fit, proportions, drape, and overall silhouette.

values.label: Layering Evaluation
values.description: Shows how multiple garments work together, including overlaps, lengths, and styling hierarchy.

values.label: Styling Reference
values.description: Shows how the outfit is styled, accessorized, and presented.

values.label: Pose Reference
values.description: Captures a pose standard that can be reused for consistent production.

values.label: Garment Detail Documentation
values.description: Documents specific details like fabric texture, trims, closures, pockets, seams, or embellishments.

values.label: Fabric Texture Visibility
values.description: Highlights material, surface texture, weave, transparency, shine, print, or fabric behavior.

values.label: Construction Detail Visibility
values.description: Highlights garment construction such as seams, pleats, darts, panels, buttons, zips, cuffs, or collars.

values.label: Accessory Visibility
values.description: Ensures accessories such as footwear, bags, belts, jewelry, hats, or eyewear are visible.

values.label: Footwear Visibility
values.description: Ensures shoes, boots, sandals, socks, and lower hem interaction are visible.

values.label: Campaign Mood
values.description: Prioritizes brand mood, aspiration, editorial styling, and visual storytelling.

values.label: Lookbook Storytelling
values.description: Shows the look as part of a styled fashion story rather than pure product documentation.

values.label: E-commerce Product Evaluation
values.description: Helps shoppers or buyers evaluate product shape, fit, styling, and usability.

values.label: Marketplace Compliance
values.description: Ensures image follows marketplace-like standards: clean, centered, visible product, minimal distraction.

values.label: QC Validation
values.description: Used to validate whether the generated image satisfies a required shot standard.
